title: 15 Days of Innocence
author: TawusGame
selftext:
I developed the game in just one week using **Gemini 3.1 Pro**. First, I wrote the **GDD** (Game Design Document), then I had the AI read it and develop the game piece by piece. Afterward, I used prompts to guide and refine the parts I didn't like or that the AI misunderstood until it was exactly what I envisioned.  


The game is currently available for free on the **Google Play Store**. There are no intrusive pop-up ads during gameplay. You can unlock the **'30 Days of Resistance'** DLC through a purchase or by watching ads, while **'15 Days of Innocence'** is completely free and ad-free.
